Preview: %1$d buckets and %2$d activity events. After you approve, PeakActivity creates and verifies an encrypted copy before replacing the existing database.
The migration did not finish. Do not clear app data; the wrapped vault key was preserved. Close other PeakActivity processes and retry.
PeakActivity helps you review app usage and local reports. Recording starts only after you choose it. Usage access can be denied; manual entry and saved reports remain available.
Reads the current URL and page title from supported browsers only when browser capture is enabled.

Browser capture uses Android Accessibility to read the current URL and page title in supported browsers. PeakActivity stores these fields in its encrypted local activity database. This source is optional and has its own off switch. Network sync is unavailable in this mobile build.

When Recording is on, PeakActivity reads app/package names and active/inactive times from UsageStats to build local reports. It does not read app screen text. This source is optional; without access, manual entries and saved reports remain available.

Media capture reads app name, track title, artist, album and playback state from active media sessions. Posted notification text is ignored. This source is optional, stored with encrypted local activity data and can be turned off separately. Network sync is unavailable in this mobile build.
Android uses a notification to show that PeakActivity’s local report service is running. This permission controls notification visibility; denying it does not enable or disable activity capture.
Recording app usage. Browser and media sources stay off unless you enable them separately.
Recording is paused. Manual entries and local reports remain available.
Usage access is off. Recording is paused; open system settings to grant access or continue in manual mode.
App usage access is off. Manual entries and local reports remain available. Tap to review system settings.
Shows today\'s screen time and top categories
Community local access. Paid sync access is unavailable.
Encrypted network sync access is available. Access is verified for every request.
Encrypted network sync access is unavailable.
Local history, export, decrypt, delete and pause remain available. Billing proof is stored separately from activity.
